description: This file is a C# source code file for an ASP.NET Core web application. It configures and defines routes/endpoints for a backend API responsible for data asset management, including CRUD operations, lineage, copy, reporting, validation, health checks, and various asset-related resources. The code sets up services, middleware, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, health endpoints, and numerous API endpoints for asset lifecycle and associated entities.
